content: {"praised":["Jeff Bridges delivers compelling, nuanced Wild Bill performance.","Direction by Walter Hill brings mythic, stylish Western tone.","Strong character depth and human drama in Wild Bill's life.","Visually engaging, well-staged action sequences.","Balanced humor and grit enhances the Western atmosphere."],"criticized":["Plot devolves into contrived, cliche-ridden train wreck.","Pacing suffers, ludicrous turns of plot.","Characters behave like bad movie tropes.","Story lacks depth, feels like a howler.","Overall film feels like a waste of time."]}
